old_caption: The video features a person standing against a plain beige background. They are wearing an orange apron with Chinese characters on it, paired with a white shirt adorned with colorful heart patterns. The individual is speaking, and the text on the left side of the screen reads "妙招姐," which translates to "Magic Tips Sister." Subtitles in Chinese appear at the bottom of the screen, changing throughout the video. Initially, the subtitle reads, "就把这个视频分享给你的家人和朋友吧," meaning "Share this video with your family and friends." This is followed by another subtitle, "这样可以帮助更多的人," translating to "This can help more people." The final subtitle says, "还有记得在下方点赞留言哦," which means "Also remember to like and leave a comment below." The person's hand gestures vary slightly between frames, suggesting they are emphasizing different points during their speech. The overall setting remains consistent, focusing on the speaker.

caption: A woman stands centered against a plain beige wall, facing the camera and speaking throughout the excerpt. She wears a white short-sleeved shirt printed with small multicolored hearts, an orange bib apron bearing white Chinese characters, a thin necklace, and a lapel microphone clipped to her apron strap. A vertical yellow logo appears at the left edge, while white Chinese subtitles along the bottom change from a request to share the video with family and friends, to a statement about helping more people, and then to a reminder to like and comment below. Her mouth opens and closes continuously, and her head tilts slightly as she talks. For most of the clip her hands are clasped low in front of her body, then her right arm lifts and she holds a downward-pointing gesture toward the bottom of the screen while the left hand remains lower near her waist.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
